description:
NEW TO THE MARKET

Outstanding 4 Bedroom Country Residence with Extensive Farmyard & c.8 Acres

Mayo Abbey, Co. Mayo

Nigel Dineen & Martin Finn Auctioneers are delighted to present this exceptional residential farm holding comprising a beautifully renovated 4-bedroom country bungalow together with a substantial farmyard, extensive outbuildings and c.8 acres of prime agricultural lands.

Located just 2 miles from the historic village of Mayo Abbey, this impressive property enjoys a highly convenient countryside location close to the N60 route, providing easy access to Claremorris, Balla, Castlebar and surrounding towns while benefiting from a strong agricultural setting in one of Mayo's most respected farming districts.

This is a rare opportunity to acquire a turnkey family home combined with an excellent agricultural holding suitable for a range of farming enterprises.

The Residence

The dwelling has been recently renovated and is presented in excellent condition throughout.

Accommodation comprises:

• Entrance Hallway
• Sitting Room
• Kitchen / Dining Room
• Utility Room
• Four Spacious Bedrooms
• Main Bathroom

Features Include:

• Recently renovated throughout
• New roof installed
• Double glazed windows
• Oil-Fired Central Heating System
• Insulated property
• Bright spacious accommodation
• Countryside views
• Excellent family home

Farmyard & Outbuildings

The farmyard is exceptionally well maintained and includes:

• 4 Bay Slatted House
• 2 Dry Bedded Bays
• Machinery Sheds
• Storage Sheds
• Dry Hay & Cattle Sheds
• Silage Slab
• Concrete Yard Area

The buildings are in excellent condition and provide outstanding facilities for livestock, machinery and fodder storage.

The Lands

• c.8 acres of prime dry agricultural lands
• Excellent road frontage
• Well fenced and easily managed holding
• Suitable for grazing, livestock or hobby farming enterprise

Location Highlights

• Approx. 2 miles from Mayo Abbey Village
• Close to Claremorris, Balla and Castlebar
• Easy access to the N60 road network
• Approx. 20 minutes to Ireland West Airport Knock
• Strong farming district with excellent agricultural infrastructure
• Peaceful countryside setting with all amenities within easy reach

This is an ideal opportunity for farmers, hobby farmers or those seeking a quality family home with substantial agricultural facilities in a prime Mayo location.

Viewing comes highly recommended and is strictly by appointment only.
